worker_visible_claims.claim: Every fitted raw SVI intercept a must be strictly positive.
The terminal maturity must contain a positive local_vol_atm computed with a backward or one-sided time difference.
max_overlap_pair must be a two-element JSON array.
Every written local-volatility grid value must be positive.
Turnover, overlap, and summary metrics must be recomputed from the final effective holdings state.

public_sources.excerpt: Forward variance must be positive for all interior expiry periods (all periods except the last, where no subsequent expiry exists to form a difference).
Verify that sigma_loc(K, T) > 0 for all grid points.
max_overlap_pair should identify the manager pair achieving the maximum overlap. Any unambiguous pair encoding is acceptable.
From the resulting effective books, compute manager-level concentration metrics, consecutive-period turnover, latest-period pairwise overlap, and latest-period security crowding.

optimize_only_sources.excerpt: All six delivered SVI intercept values were below zero while the official output property requires a > 0.
The expected property says local_vol_atm is finite and positive at every maturity; the observed terminal maturity row is missing local_vol_atm.
The maximum-overlap pair is serialized as one joined label instead of a two-label sequence.
